text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper’s primary objective is to model climate change impacts on crop suitability for apple and kiwifruit in New Zealand using biologically informed continuous suitability models. While it does generate national-scale land-use projections under two future climate scenarios (RCP 2.6 and RCP 8.5), these LULC predictions are not the central focus but rather a downstream application of the suitability models. The LULC projections are derived by feeding suitability scores into a pre-existing econometric land-use model (LURNZ), which was developed elsewhere. The core innovation and emphasis lie in the bias-corrected climate data, crop suitability modeling, and integration with economic constraints—not in developing or validating a LULC prediction framework per se. Thus, LULC prediction serves as an applied step rather than the primary research question.)
